description.value: Amogha Indian Kitchen & Bar is a full-service Indian restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street built around twelve distinct regional cuisines — from Hyderabadi dum biryani to Malabar moilee — developed after two years of research across the subcontinent. The kitchen pairs regionally-specific cooking with a craft cocktail bar built on Indian aromatics like tamarind, cardamom, and saffron. With 80 seats and a menu extensively marked for dietary preferences, it is a substantial dining stop for cyclists riding the Main Street corridor.
